verdict: BOUNDARY (SMOKE(1-seed), build-informative) -- the fully-spiking EXPERIENCE-BOUND opponent V+/V- population (weights conditioned on ~10 innate primaries, Warriner-FREE) ALSO fails to retire the gate. STEELMANNED across three biologically-motivated held-out reads (total opponent DRIVE, valence |differential|, relatedness-residualized drive), the BEST (total_drive) recovers worst-case recall=0.000 at joint FP=0 -- BELOW the 0.5 bar AND below the refuted co-occurrence-magnitude negative control (0.085) on the same words. The no-conditioning lesion reads 0.000 (the read IS experience-driven, but the experience doesn't separate). DECISIVE: the conditioning channel itself (no bridge) separates at only 0.141 recall@FP0 at its BEST pairing window (1-4 swept) -- so this is NOT a spiking operating-point artifact. DIAGNOSIS: the ~10 innate primaries (hug/hurt/cry/warm) live INSIDE the same TinyStories narrative register as the neutral words (cat/day/moon co-occur with warm/cozy in emotionally-resolved scenes), so conditioning-to-primaries is STILL a co-occurrence statistic inheriting the SAME register confound -- because in a TEXT-ONLY stream the 'experienced affect' IS the text co-occurrence. The genuinely different channel needs a NON-TEXTUAL experience source (an embodied/interoceptive US from the world+body, the way amygdala conditioning binds to real reinforcement delivery, not narrative company). FAILED: ['G1_recall>=0.5', 'G2_surpass_negctrl']. The fixed _STRONG_MARGIN gate in affect_production_organ.py is UNCHANGED (this file wires nothing).
